text:
Maya: Quick sync  Finance found several tenants where invoice_preview != final_invoice after regional failover to Dedicated during a recent spike. Root cause looks like finalizer appending a priced event instead of replacing the preview.
Omar: Can we see a sample?
Maya: Example: same request id but two records (preview from router, final from finalizer with price_override). Downstream invoice builder sums both.
Pri: We should standardize on a canonical billing key so consumers can dedupe. Proposal: canonical_key = tenant|req_id|route_resolution_id|billing_epoch. Router writes preview with preview=true and preview_id set. Finalizer upserts into a compacted topic keyed by canonical_key and sets finalized=true. Invoice builder reads the compacted topic snapshot.
Jules: Upsert + compaction sounds right. Avoids forcing every preview consumer to implement replace semantics. Also add a tiny in-memory cache at finalizer for immediate duplicate suppression (few seconds TTL) to reduce write churn.
Omar: Concern: any extra lookups on hot path to compute route_resolution_id could add p50. Can router annotate records with billing_metadata (route_group, preview_id) so finalizer doesn't need to join.
Pri: Agreed. Router will add billing_metadata. We'll version the proto so old consumers ignore the new fields.
Maya: UX/Finance: Console should surface "pending_pricing" rows and include preview_id in CSV exports. Finance wants a reconciliation job to collapse the last 48-72h by canonical key and emit corrections where required.
Jules: Metrics: emit preview_count, finalized_count, and preview_to_final_delta_usd per tenant. Add alert if delta >0.25% over 30m.
ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled: finalizer v2.5.0 canary at 1% tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Maya: Action items: 1) define canonical key proto (Pri), 2) router emits billing_metadata (Omar), 3) create compacted topic invoices.canonical (Jules+Pri), 4) finalizer upsert + tiny cache (Jules). I'll open the reconciliation ticket and attach samples.
Pri: I'll PR schema changes and the backfill job.
Omar: I'll coordinate router changes and quick perf test.
Jules: I'll provision the compacted topic and add dashboards.
Maya: Thanks, team. Short-term this should fix double-counting and make invoice preview behavior deterministic.
